tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// hūm̐ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /'od zer bye ba 'phro ba bzhengs// mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal// gnyis med sbyor ba khyod rgyal bstod// zla ba lta bu'i zhal dgu pa// lha dang lha min thams cad kun// ma lus par ni 'jigs par mdzad// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang brjid pas gnas// stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo ya ma a ri/ mi'u thung sgeg po sprin lta'i mdog 'od zer rnam par 'phros pas bzhengs// mtshan ma legs po ma he'i zhal// 'jig mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'dzin// gnyis pas mtshon rtse gcig pa 'dzin// gsum pa'i phyag gis gtun shing 'dzin// bzhi pas chu gri bzang po 'dzin// lnga pas rdo rje rtse gcig 'dzin// drug pa na ni sta re 'dzin// bdun pa'i phyag gis mdung thung 'dzin// brgyad pa na ni mda' 'dzin zhing*// dgu pa'i phyag gis lcags kyu 'dzin// bcu pa'i phyag gis dbyug tho 'dzin// bcu gcig pa na kha ṭwaṃ' ga /bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo 'dzin// bcu gsum pa yis rdo rje 'dzin// bcu bzhi rdung don tho ba bsnams// bco lnga dgra gsod ral gri 'dzin// bcu drug cang te'u gnyis med 'dzin// de ltar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin// gnyis pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams// gsum pas shes rab phub 'dzin te// bzhi pas bsgrub bya'i rkang pa 'dzin// lnga pas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin// drug pas gzhu 'dzin thabs kyi don// bdun pas nyon mongs rgyu ma 'dzin// brgyad pas shes rab dril bu 'khrol// dgu pas rdeg don lag pa 'dzin// bcu pas mnyes don dur khrod ras// skyes bu gsal shing bcu gcig pa// bcu gnyis sreg don me thab 'dzin// bcu gsum ye shes thod tshal 'dzin// bcu bzhi sdigs mdzub bsdigs par mdzad// bco lnga 'phan bsnams dug gsum 'joms// bsgrub bya rlung bskur bcu drug ras// yon tan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// mi dang ma he glang bong bu// rnga mo khyi lug wa dang brgyad// 'di brgyad g.yas pa'i zhabs brgyad kyis// brgya byin tshangs pa'i steng nas gnon// nang brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bya rgod 'ug pa khwa ne tsho// khra dang khyung ngang ri skegs bzhad// 'di brgyad g.yon pa'i zhabs brgyad kyis// khyab 'jug drag po'i steng nas gnon// gdon brgyad 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan// gzhal yas me dpung dkyil na bzhugs// 'jigs mdzad sku la phyag 'tshal lo// brgya phyed mgo bo'i do shal can// dbu la thod pa lnga yis brgyan// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// zhal dgu pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// spyan mig nyi shu rtsa bdun dmar// ljags 'dril zhal nas ha has bzhad// mtshan dang dpe byad yang dag ldan// ma he'i zhal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal rdo rje 'jig byed kyi bstod pa/

༄༅// bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos po kun gyi de nyid chos dbyings kun rtog bral// thog ma dbus dang tha ma las grol nam mkha'i dngos// blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs ldan pas// rnam par mdzes pa he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs can sku che mdangs gnag tshad thung la// 'jig dus me yi 'od mnga' khams gsum za nus pa// brgya byin tshangs pa dbang phyug nyi ma zla// gzhon nu la sogs lha rnams 'jigs par mdzad la 'dud// mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng zhing ma he'i zhal du brjid// ha ha phaṭa phaṭa ces sgra sgrogs shing ljags 'dril ba// 'jigs pa'i khro gnyer smin ma yon po dang bcas pa'i// spyan gsum bgrad pa thod pa'i phreng thod can la bstod// gcer bu'i lus la dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan// sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs 'chang g.yon brkyang gar// gsus khyim che la sha khrag rkang tshil gsol// 'jigs byed chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal dgu nyi shu bdun gyi spyan// sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag mnga' zhing*// bcu drug zhabs kyis rab tu 'gyings// dur khrod rol la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa zhal ma he g.yas kyi rwar gnas pa'i// zhal gsum sngon po dmar po ser po ni// shin tu khros pa de bzhin g.yon gyi zhal// dkar po dud kha nag po khro zhing 'gyur// rwa yi dbus zhal dmar zhing khrag 'dzag 'jigs// steng zhal gser 'od cung zad khros pa la// zur phud lnga dang byis rgyan me tog thod// spyan gsum mnga' ba'i zhal dgu la phyag 'tshal// gri gug rtse gcig gtun shing chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa// sta re mdud dang mda' dang lcags kyu dbyugs tho kha ṭwāṃ ga /'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga tho ba ral gri ḍā ma ru// g.yas kyi bcu drug na 'dzin thod pa mgo bo phub chung dang*// rkang pa zhags pa gzhu dang rgyu ma dril bu lag pa dang*// dur khrod ras dang skyes bu gsal shing gis phug me yi thab// btung snod sdigs mdzub ba dan rtse gsum rlung dar g.yon pa yi// bcu drug na 'dzin 'og mas glang po'i pags pa bsnams la 'dud// drag po la sogs dregs pa chen po'i chen po rnams// khyed kyi zhabs zung khums pas skrag pas brgyal gyur nas// phyogs bcur lang long gyur pas sa la 'gyel mdzad cing*// de dag steng na zhabs kyi mdun gyis brdzis pa ni// mi dang ma he khyu mchog bong bu rnga mo dang*// khyi dang lug dang ce spyang g.yas kyi zhabs kyis brdzis// bya rgod 'ug pa bya rog khwa khyung chen// khyim bya bzhad mnan g.yon brkyang gar mdzad la phyag 'tshal// mgon po khyod ni khams gsum bdag nyid la sogs dang*// dngos grub brgyad stsol de bzhin dbang phyug brgyad nyid dang*// nyon mongs gcod pa la sogs de nyid don ston phyir// zhal dang zhabs dang phyag mang mnga' ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig lha dang klu dang phyogs skyong ba rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang 'dre dang ro langs 'byung po du mas gang*// bya rog 'ug pa ce spyang hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs// chu bo sprin dang me dang shing chen 'jigs pas brgyan// skyes bu dpyangs pa dang ni shing rtser btsugs dang sreg la sogs// ro rnams rgyu ma nar dang klad pa mthong ba dang*// dum bur gyur dang rul dang keng rus kyis gang ba// rnal 'byor rol pa dur khrod 'jigs pa tshal chen du// mgon po khyod ni sems can don kun mdzad pa'i phyir// snying rje khros pa'i dad sgrol nyid kyis hrīḥṣṭ+rī yi// sngags dang gar gyis srid gsum 'khrul pa gcod mdzad cing*// bde chen ngo bos rol pa mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dgu'i rang bzhin nyams dgu'i zhal ldan zhing*// bdud 'joms stong nyid dngos grub bcu drug zhabs// byang chub lha ni phyag dang gsang ba'i gnas// rgyud gsum gnyis med ngo bo nyid la 'dud// thos shing mthong bas dad pa'i rlabs g.yos nas// yun gyi dpal dang mgon du bgyi ba'i phyir// 'bad rtsol dka' bas khyod kyi zhabs bsten nas// thugs rje chen pos bdag la byin gyis rlobs// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa las// byung ba'i dge ba dri med gang thob des// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyis// 'jam dbyangs khro chen rgyal po thob par shog

/rje btsun bsod nams mtha' yas rtser gyur pas// 'jam dbyangs khro chen rgyal por bstod mdzad pa// mi shes bzhin du grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis// tshigs su bcad pa bzhi zhig zhabs tog bgyis// dge par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ bha wa tu/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
